svg.title: Conn3x bridges infrastructure as code and configuration management: one binary, one plan, one state. 10 clouds and hypervisors, 128 circuits, 135 repos in the org.
svg.text: The gap was never supposed to be there.
Creating a server and setting it up are one job. Now it's one tool.
EVERY LIGHT IS A CIRCUIT YOU DON'T HAVE TO WRITE
